supporting_observations.claim: At 13:45 UTC, mia.santos opened Statement.docm in Word; Word then spawned PowerShell with no-profile, hidden-window, and encoded-command options.
The encoded PowerShell command decodes to an expression that downloads and executes a script from raw.githubusercontent.com/bluefin-it/tools/main/u.ps1.

PowerShell made two connections through the explicit proxy shortly after starting; the connections transferred response data, although the available connection records do not identify the requested URLs or content.
PowerShell then launched rundll32 to invoke an Init entry point in a DLL under mia.santos's roaming AppData directory.
The reported time is approximate: at 13:40 UTC the logs show a Defender scan, while the suspicious Word-to-PowerShell chain appears at 13:45 UTC.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy logs for 2026-09-29 13:20–14:10 UTC were not collected, according to the supplied sensor coverage status; this includes the suspicious PowerShell network activity.
Zeek connection records show connections to the proxy and transfer sizes, but do not establish the requested URL or downloaded content.
The supplied records do not include the contents or hashes of Statement.docm, u.ps1, or svchelper.dll, nor a Defender verdict for these files.
claims_not_established: The exact content and behavior of the downloaded PowerShell script and svchelper.dll are not established by these records.
The initial delivery source of Statement.docm and whether mia.santos intentionally opened it are not established.
The evidence does not show whether the DLL established persistence or whether additional systems were affected.
additional_evidence_needed: Preserve and analyze Statement.docm, svchelper.dll, and any recovered copy of u.ps1; record hashes and determine provenance.
Review email, browser-download, and file-origin records for Statement.docm.
Retrieve endpoint Defender detection and scan results, and collect relevant endpoint forensic data to assess execution, persistence, and impact.
Recover proxy records or other network evidence for 13:45 UTC, if available, to identify the requested URL and response content.
unrelated_findings: Google Drive File Stream and Dropbox were launched on WS-MSANTOS-01; the inventory says no file-sharing or cloud-storage services other than Microsoft 365/OneDrive and Cloudkeep are approved.
